text:
Ruth: Quick a11y tidy on the insights list pagination — found a few small but noisy issues when using VoiceOver + keyboard: disabled prev/next buttons aren't being announced as disabled, focus lands on the first item but VR reads the whole list as a live update causing duplication, and our page number buttons don't use aria-current so SRs don't say which page is active. Posting short repros.

a11y-bot: Scan summary: 6 aria-roles missing (nav/label), 3 announce-duplicates (aria-live verbosity), 2 contrast flags (small chevrons on light theme). Full mock report: https://internal/reports/a11y/2061234567 (placeholder).

Ben: Can you paste steps? I couldn't repro in ChromeVox earlier.

Ruth: Steps (Safari + VoiceOver):
1) Open Insights > Results list (paginated)
2) Tab to pagination controls, press Next to go to page 2
Expected: focus moves to top of results and SR announces "Page 2 of 5" (once) and optionally the range "Results 21 to 40"
Actual: VO announces "Page 2 of 5" then immediately repeats with the entire result summary because our aria-live on the list updates with a verbose template. Also the Prev button still reads as "button" (not "disabled, button"). DOM snippets:```html
<nav class="pager">
  <button class="prev" aria-label="Previous page">‹</button>
  <button class="page">1</button>
  <button class="page">2</button>
  <button class="next" aria-label="Next page">›</button>
</nav>
<section id="results" aria-live="polite">...list items...</section>```

Tara: Sounds like two separate problems: (1) missing aria-disabled/aria-current semantics on controls, (2) overly chatty live region. Also need to ensure focus management happens after DOM updates (race).

Jamal: Proposed fixes:
- Mark disabled buttons: `button[disabled]` or `aria-disabled="true"` and include `aria-label` that matches e.g. "Previous page, disabled" is redundant if aria-disabled is present, but beneficial for some older SRs.
- Use `aria-current="page"` on the active page button so SRs announce the active state. Example: `<button class=\"page\" aria-current=\"page\">2</button>`
- Put the pagination inside `nav role="navigation" aria-label="Pagination"` so it appears in SR rotor.

Priya: For the live region: change strategy to a minimal polite region that only announces the range, not entire list markup. Instead of `aria-live` on `#results`, set `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"` on a concise offscreen node and update text like `"Showing 21 to 40 of 103"`. Keep the full list DOM free of live updates.

Ruth: Focus handling: call focus on the results container after the new page content is mounted, but use a focusable container with tabindex="-1" to avoid inserting into tab order. Example JS:```js
const results = document.getElementById('results');
results.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');
results.focus(); // after content mount
// Update an aria-live text node instead of bubbling full DOM
document.getElementById('pager-announcement').textContent = `Showing ${start} to ${end} of ${total}`;
```
Include a small debounce to ensure focus happens after React hydration.

Ben: Also watch out for duplicate announcements: some assistive tech will announce aria-current change plus the aria-live text. Suggest we detect if aria-current is supported on the client SR and gate the live text as a fallback. Simpler: keep the live announcement minimal and avoid repeating page label e.g., don't announce "Page 2" in both aria-current and live region. Live region should focus on numeric range only.

Jamal: CSS/visual: ensure prev/next icons have accessible hit target and >3:1 contrast in both themes. Also apply `:focus-visible` outlines on page buttons with 2px high-contrast ring; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Priya: Testing notes: add Axe checks for nav/label, a small VoiceOver manual case that confirms only one announcement on page change, and an e2e keyboard test that: Tab to pager, activate Next, asserts `document.activeElement` is the results container and `#pager-announcement` text was updated. Attach before/after screenshots and a short VoiceOver recording in the PR.

Ruth: I'll open a tiny PR that: adds nav/aria-label, aria-current on active page, aria-disabled on prev/next when applicable, replaces aria-live on full list with a concise `#pager-announcement` live node, and focuses results container after mount. Assigning to @Ben for review. :rocket:

Ben: Thanks — please include the small compat guard and the tests. I'll review tonight. :thumbsup:
